items.title: How replication lag turns into records at risk of loss
items.description: RPO isn't just a duration — it's the number of writes that could vanish if a failure happens at the worst possible moment. This uses this unit's own worst-case-lag logic: potential records at risk = replication lag (in seconds) × write rate. Drag the lag up toward what the Scenario's async-replicated database might see under load to see how quickly exposure grows.
items.compute: const potentialLostRecords = Math.round(params.replicationLagSec * params.writesPerSecond); return { potentialLostRecords };

outputs.label: Records at risk of loss on failover

items.title: How much a second independent region actually buys you
items.description: This unit's combinedAnnualDowntimeMinutes function assumes independent regions, where the system is down only if every region fails at once. Because independent probabilities multiply, adding a region doesn't just modestly help — it can cut downtime by orders of magnitude. Drag the region count up to see the drop, and drag the per-region failure rate up to see how a shakier region changes the payoff.
items.compute: const p = params.regionDowntimePercent / 100; const n = Math.round(params.numRegions); const combinedProbability = Math.pow(p, n); const minutesPerYear = 365 * 24 * 60; const combinedAnnualDowntimeMinutes = combinedProbability * minutesPerYear; return { combinedAnnualDowntimeMinutes };
